normalized.summary: Yaneer Bar-Yam, Asia-Pacific zero COVID coalition concept paper, New England Complex Systems Institute (January 30, 2021). Download PDF The Asia-Pacific Zero COVID Coalition (“AZCC”) is envisioned as a grouping of Asia-Pacific jurisdictions committed to achieving a COVID-free world by promoting the “Zero COVID” approach to coronavirus elimination.
